item.title: Core Studies: Hebrews 1-4 (Week 5)
item.description:
Consider Jesus from the book of Hebrews, chapters 1-4.
Hebrews invites us to consider, or think deeply about Jesus at many times and in many ways. Have you considered Jesus as Son, as Word, as apostle and as great high priest? Come explore these considerations as we deep dive into the first four chapters of Hebrews over the next five weeks.
